a.xlink:title: Internal helper: the component pairs one stored product carries.
Fills a window's storage from the particles sampling each cell at one instant.
Merges a window's pointwise state over homogeneous directions.
Internal helper: fills one recipe ensemble's storage from the loaded step.
A cell's particles form the same state the streaming accumulator builds.
Derives and writes field statistics for the windows a recipe requests.
Entry point for the postprocessor executable.
Entry point for the accumulator suite.
Writes a window's statistics merged over homogeneous directions as a profile.
A homogeneous merge equals the moments of the slot's pooled sample set.
A homogeneous merge of a particle-sampled field pools only its occupied samples.
A point_variance profile is the plane mean of each point's own variance.
A wall-normal profile CSV holds each plane's pooled moments on any decomposition.
Internal helper: writes one window's or ensemble's derived output for a step.
Runs the serial/MPI post-processing compute regression suite.
